attributions.chapter: CHAPTER 21 A GOODBYE AND AN INTRODUCTION: ASPECTS OF MULTIDIMENSIONAL PERSONALITY AS VIEWED THROUGH MY OWN EXPERIENCE
attributions.surface_quote: You are not fated to dissolve into All That Is; individuality is retained.

attributions.surface_quote: Such a consciousness is present within all living beings, and in all forms.
